breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The user's request set up the domain height and water column along the Y-axis but incorrectly specified gravity in the -Z direction. The Agent repeated this error, specifying `g (0 0 -9.81);`. For the simulation to work as intended, the gravity vector should have been corrected to act along the -Y axis, i.e., `g (0 -9.81 0);`.
